title: Brazilian Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich and creamy chocolate mousse with a hint of silky texture, perfect for a dessert.
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the unsalted butter, silky chocolate, and granulated sugar to the melted chocolate.
Whisk until smooth and well combined.
Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture.
Add the vanilla extract and whisk until combined.
Pour into individual serving cups and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
